meta.title: A live RFQ with no bids lists the invited vendor under "Offer submissions"

direct.expectedResult: HTTP 200. Offer submissions lists exactly one vendor (QA vendor 1) with the RFQ round under 'Bid Pending For', no last-reminded time and remindable (can_remind true); pending evaluations, counter offers, best offer, cost breakdown and auction reminders are null; approvals null unless the company has a pending approval on the event.

assert.say: one vendor is pending an offer
the pending vendor is QA vendor 1
